Prisene ligger i databasen, ikke i koden: The prices live in the database, not in the code: Initial assessment NOK 1,290 (60 minutes), Follow-up appointment NOK 790 (30 minutes), Shockwave therapy NOK 690 (30 minutes) and Movement analysis NOK 1,490 (60 minutes), the same with every practitioner. An administrator can change them in the admin panel without a new deployment.
Bookingmotoren regner med mandag–fredag: The booking engine works with Monday–Friday 07:00–15:00 with the therapists and 06:00–13:00 with Markus, in 30-minute slots. Weekends are closed. Available times are generated from these hours and from what is already booked.
Avbestilling går inntil 24 timer før tim: You can cancel up to 24 hours before the appointment, with the reference code from the confirmation. Try it: book an appointment, and use the code on the cancellation page.
Bruk «Bestill time». Du velger behandler: Use “Book appointment”. You choose practitioner, service and time, and get a reference code at the end. Your booking becomes an ordinary row you can change and delete, unlike the rows that came with the demo.
Alt du legger inn slettes ved den nattli: Everything you enter is deleted by the nightly reset, except files you upload under Documents. The rows that came with the demo are write-protected in the database: the buttons work, but saving is refused with an explanation, so the panel looks the same for the next visitor.
